description: A Codex turn that gives up (cannot reach the endpoint) shows fail and keeps it at rest; the next turn starts clean; an interrupt is not a failure; a non-zero exit is.
provenance: Authored, not recorded. The 'Reconnect failed' line is the one herdr's codex manifest names; the interrupt line ('■ Conversation interrupted') is from Orca's codex tests. Unverified against a live failing Codex.

steps.out: [2J[4;1H› run the migration[6;1H• Working (30s • esc to interrupt)[20;1H› Ask Codex to do anything[22;3H? for shortcuts
[6;1H[K• Reconnect failed — check the endpoint, then relaunch (35s)
[2J[4;1H› try again[6;1H• Working (0s • esc to interrupt)[20;1H› Ask Codex to do anything
[6;1H[K■ Conversation interrupted - tell the model what to do differently.
steps.note: an interrupt is rest, not a failure
